FINDINGS.where: disease-models/wwox/analysis/comparison_notes/2026-09-13_M4B_PMID24369382.md section C, 44 lines below repaired Site 5, in the same file
FINDINGS.what: The bullet asserts that abolition is 'an overstatement for the WW1-only construct' whose 'honest reading is strong reduction with residual binding' — three things the blind R4 in CC-20260913-24369382-02 refused: 'residual binding' is among the three refused words; 'at the wild-type band's height' is contradicted by measurement (centroid ~14 px BELOW lane 1's, no band edges, no lane registration); and a per-construct result claim IN EITHER DIRECTION is the reader's addition because the paper draws no per-construct claim to overstate.
FINDINGS.not_a_defect: The MEASUREMENT survives and I do not propose deleting it: the WWOX1-mutant lane is not blank, and it is visibly above the emptiness of the WWOX1-2-mutant lane. The R4 confirms both. The defect is the inference layered on the measurement.
FINDINGS.why_the_rejection_failed: The note was HONEST when written — it says in its own words that R4 had not run for it and that any repair must run R4 first. The R4 then ran and refused it. The producer, editing this very file, read the R4, classified line 116 as 'already true', and leaned on the refused sentence as the stated justification for repairing Site 5. The R4's result propagated upward into the section B row and not backward into the section C bullet the section B repair cites as its authority.
FINDINGS.proposed_not_applied: Keep the measurement; replace the inference with the R4's own boundary wording, which exists and was drafted for exactly this purpose.

FINDINGS.severity: a coverage claim that overstates its own scope
FINDINGS.what: The dispositions assert 'zero surviving occurrences in any file I own' after re-running the multi-spelling sweep. Twelve occurrences stand today under disease-models/wwox/ in spellings the producer's own recorded sweep pattern covers ('livelli normali', 'normal protein', 'abolito'), in two non-canonical scientist-writable ledgers and one dossier, dispositioned NEITHER as repaired NOR as rejected. discovery_ledger_current.md:351 is the withdrawn clause as THE REASON GIVEN INSIDE A RETRACTION — character-for-character the construction repaired at Sites 1, 2 and 4.
FINDINGS.the_point: This is stronger than 'a spelling nobody searched for': the spelling WAS searched and the hits were not reported. The scoping phrase 'in any file I own' is technically load-bearing and materially misleading in a record whose purpose is to close a residual.
FINDINGS.proposed_not_applied: Not that scientist-a should have repaired them — ownership is a real question and DL-MECH-033 is the table CLAIM 030 rests on. That each site be DISPOSITIONED: listed, with an owner, and either repaired at T0 by its owner or declared as a residual the way the two canonical rows were.

FINDINGS.severity: recorded as a near-miss, NOT reported as a defect
FINDINGS.what: PMID42128308_partial_locators.md:149 reads 'Normal protein with a severe phenotype'. My first reading scored 'severe phenotype' as a second independent error, since every local record assigns P47T the MILD phenotype. Checked against the context before reporting: the sentence brackets a MOUSE result against a human organoid result, and the P47T MOUSE does carry a severe phenotype — chronic generalised convulsive epilepsy, ~4-fold Purkinje loss, survival 393 +/- 32 d against 542 +/- 8. Defensible; withdrawn as a finding.
FINDINGS.why_recorded: Had I reported it I would have called for the deletion of a true statement in order to obey my own verification error — the failure this task was warned about twice, in both directions. Only the 'normal protein' half stands, and it is listed under FINDING_2.

UNVERIFIABLE_HERE: files/fulltext/PMID42128308_Aqeilan2026_fitz.txt is absent from this checkout (files/ is gitignored by design, the repository's intended layering and not a fault), so what the Aqeilan 2026 review actually says about P47T protein levels could not be verified and no finding of mine rests on it. The verbatim QUOTATION at line 136 is therefore UNVERIFIABLE_HERE and is not charged as a repair-by-quotation defect; the un-attributed restatement at line 149, in the reader's own voice, is a defect independent of what the review says. entries[19] is a persisted locator whose amendment is a tracked contradiction-procedure act, and pathograph_export.jsonl is a derived surface regenerated by the orchestrator — the route is proposed, not the edit.

DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED.what: M4B_PMID24369382 section C's measurement survives the R4 while every inference from it is refused, including that the WW1-only construct differs from the tandem one in RESULT. That leaves a measured two-lane asymmetry nobody may interpret in either direction. The R4 itself declares this UNRESOLVED, having run a control against its own conclusion: lane 3's unsaturated doublet bleeds only ~40-60 px while lane 1's feature reaches ~200 px, but lane 1 is clipped to black and horizontally elongated, the classic source of halation — so the control neither establishes bleed nor establishes a band.
DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED.what_would_resolve_it: Source data or an unsaturated re-exposure of Mallaret Figure 3; or a per-construct pull-down repeated with non-saturating exposure and lane registration. Absent either, the honest terminal state is the R4's, and no record should resolve it in either direction.
